response.justification: The candidate is a clearly capable, versatile senior engineer with 15+ years of experience, but their profile is heavily oriented toward web and full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang). Professional C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015, and there is no evidence of the role's core requirements: modern C++/STL depth, message brokers at scale in C++, MQTT/IoT interfaces, IEC 62443 or SDL security practices, or industrial automation protocols. The mismatch on the primary technical stack outweighs strong general engineering credentials.
strengths: Extensive senior-level software engineering experience with strong craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing)
Proven low-latency, high-throughput systems work (millions of requests/sec) with async I/O and concurrency in DLang
Strong mentoring and knowledge-sharing track record (workshops, talks, courses)
concerns: Minimal and outdated professional C++ experience (last hands-on C/C++ role ended in 2015)
No exposure to industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443), SDL, or automation protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, MQTT)
Career trajectory firmly in web/full-stack and cloud tooling, not industrial automation or embedded platform development

key_factors.factor: No industrial security or protocol experience
